messages:
nina: Quick heads-up — I'm opening quota increase requests for IP resources in us-east-1 and ap-southeast-1 to support a planned inference fleet expansion next month. Need owners and exact counts per account.

keith: Thanks. Can you list account IDs and the delta for ENIs / secondary IPv4 / EIPs / IPv6 prefixes per region?

nina: Yep. Breakdown (all numbers are additional headroom requested):
- infra-core (222233334444): us-east-1 +90 ENIs, +360 secondary IPv4, +80 EIPs, request /56 IPv6 pool
- infra-stage (222233334445): us-east-1 +25 ENIs, +100 IPv4, +25 EIPs
- infra-dedicated (222233334446): ap-southeast-1 +40 ENIs, +160 IPv4, +60 EIPs, /56 IPv6
- infra-backup (222233334447): ap-southeast-1 +12 ENIs, +48 IPv4

ravi: Are those EIPs going to be long-lived? If they're mostly ephemeral for burst nodes we should note that in the request so AWS doesn't deny based on historic allocations. Also, check per-AZ ENI caps — we hit weird per-AZ limits last quarter.

oncall: What support plan do these accounts use? ETA varies a lot between Business and Enterprise.

nina: infra-core is Enterprise, others are Business.

keith: Nice. Please include a short justification block in each case, e.g.:
```
Workload: Dedicated model serving and NAT/egress for NLBs during rollout.
Planned scale: +30-90 instances per account (varies), average 2 ENIs per instance, up to 4 secondary private IPv4 addresses used per instance for service routing.
Request: Regional ENI and Elastic IP increases and allocation of a /56 IPv6 block for each specified account, to enable IPv6-first testing and reduce IPv4 pressure.
```

ravi: Also add that we'll reuse EIPs where possible and deallocate detached EIPs quickly. Mention cost-awareness.

nina: Will do. Creating cases now. Please paste escalation emails for each account — I'll cc finance/security where relevant.

oncall: Pulling contact list. Use: infra-core@redwood.com, infra-stage@redwood.com, infra-dedicated@redwood.com, infra-backup@redwood.com. Filing cases shortly.

cloudops-bot: Created AWS support case 9876543210 for infra-core us-east-1 (ENI/EIP/IPv6). Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=9876543210

keith: Helpful command to verify current quotas locally if anyone needs it:
```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-xxxxxxxx --region us-east-1
# replace quota-code with the appropriate quota id for ENIs/EIPs/IPv4-per-eni
```

ravi: Note on IPv6: some of our VPCs already have /56s assigned which consumes the per-account IPv6 prefix quota. Ask AWS to confirm available IPv6 prefix pool and to grant a /56 rather than a /64. Also request subnet auto-assign flags be enabled where applicable.

nina: Attached network diagram and traffic projections to case 9876543210. Also opened separate cases: 9876543211 (infra-stage us-east-1), 9876543212 (infra-dedicated ap-southeast-1), 9876543213 (infra-backup ap-southeast-1).

cloudops-bot: AWS replied to 9876543210 requesting additional usage history and a short validation plan.

keith: Validation plan suggestion: create a controlled burst of 15 instances, attach ENIs and secondary IPs, allocate EIPs and assign to NLBs, request IPv6 /56 assignment to a test VPC. Verify no allocation errors and measure attach latency.

nina: Added that plan to the ticket plus a link to the runbook PR. Also noted we'll deallocate unused EIPs within 24 hours. CC'ing @finance for cost visibility and @security for IPv6/KMS considerations.

finance: Please include an estimated monthly cost delta for allocated EIPs and potential burst traffic — we'll need to add it to next month's forecast.

nina: Quick estimate: assuming 120 additional EIPs across both regions and partial-hour detach time, rough monthly cost delta ~ $1.8k - $3k. I'll refine once AWS confirms counts.

cloudops-bot: Update: provisional increases granted for infra-core us-east-1: ENIs +50, EIPs +40, secondary IPv4 +200 pending verification. Full request under review. Case 9876543210.

ravi: Good. Once provisional goes through, run the validation steps in a low-risk VPC/AZ. If any per-AZ cap hits, escalate to AWS account manager.

oncall: I'll monitor and post results here. If provisional validation passes, we'll ask for the remaining headroom. :thumbsup:

nina: Thanks all. I'll post the provisioning test results and update the tickets. If you want to run the quota queries locally, ping me and I'll paste exact quota codes per resource.

cloudops-bot: Case 9876543210 updated: validation required. AWS assigned case owner and requested contact email.

nina: Contact for AWS: infra-core@redwood.com (primary), ops-escalation@redwood.com (secondary). Validation run scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

keith: Great — ping here when it's done and I'll kick off the test CloudFormation stack.

ravi: Also adding a note to the infra-runbook about IPv6 allocation constraints and EIP reuse best practices so we don't repeat ad-hoc requests.

nina: Added. Thanks team.

cloudops-bot: Next update will be posted in the support case.
